# Authentication Architecture and Multi-Card Flow

> Technical specification for enterprise multi-card authentication, local break-glass recovery, and OIDC dance sequencing.

## Overview and Scope

System architecture for enterprise identity integration. Supports multiple concurrent identity providers with deterministic claim resolution and strict tenant isolation.

## Authentication Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as User Browser
    participant App as Kanban Web
    participant Auth as Auth Service
    participant IdP as Identity Provider
    User->>App: Click Login with OIDC
    App->>Auth: Initiate OAuth Flow (PKCE S256)
    Auth->>IdP: Redirect to IdP Auth URL
    IdP-->>User: Present Login Challenge
    User->>IdP: Provide Credentials
    IdP-->>Auth: Callback with Authorization Code
    Auth->>IdP: Exchange Code + PKCE Verifier for Tokens
    IdP-->>Auth: ID Token + Access Token
    Auth->>App: Issue Session Cookie
    App-->>User: Render Dashboard
```

## Security Invariants

1. Zero plaintext tokens in localStorage.
2. PKCE code verifier generated using cryptographically secure random bytes.
3. Session cookie marked Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax.
